title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17

ai_review.summary: A hot 1982 Warfield show captured on a patched soundboard with solid audio that lets the standout Scarlet > Fire and Estimated Prophet jams shine.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about the high‑energy performance – especially the scorching Scarlet > Fire transition, a jazzy Bird Song jam, and a fiery Estimated Prophet. The soundboard source is generally clear and lively, though a few reviewers note hiss and occasional patch‑switching that can make it sound a bit flat at times.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (13/15) give 4‑5 stars and praise both the musical fire and overall sound quality; only a few note minor audio flaws, so the combined show + recording rating is strong.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Patched SBD with occasional hiss and AUD‑patch switching; most listeners find it clear and lively, though a few mention the high‑end sounding harsh without EQ.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set builds into a scorching second set; seamless transitions especially Scarlet > Fire and the Estimated Prophet jam keep momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Warfield venue seems to get Jerry going; many note his energized playing throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: A few listeners wish for more Phil in the mix, mentioning he is quiet until "Loser" and could use a little more presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob's antics make listeners laugh and add fun energy to the show.
